   220	    (hZ₁ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective Z₁)
   221	    (hZ₂ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective Z₂)
   222	    (hXZ : ∀ a b, X₁.effect a * Z₂.effect b = Z₂.effect b * X₁.effect a)
   223	    (hZX : ∀ a b, Z₁.effect b * X₂.effect a = X₂.effect a * Z₁.effect b)
   224	    (hZZ : ∀ b, Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b = Z₂.effect b * Z₁.effect b) :
   225	    ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 - ∑ ab : α × β, stateQForm ψ

   227	          (Z₂.effect ab.2 * X₂.effect ab.1 * Z₂.effect ab.2)) ≤
   228	      (1 / 2) * ∑ b, ‖applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b - Z₂.effect b) ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   229	        (3 / 2) * ((∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a) ψ‖ ^ 2) +
   230	          (∑ ab : α × β, ‖applyOperatorToState
   231	            (X₁.effect ab.1 * Z₁.effect ab.2 -
   232	              Z₁.effect ab.2 * X₁.effect ab.1) ψ‖ ^ 2) +
   233	          ∑ ab : α × β, ‖applyOperatorToState
   234	            (X₂.effect ab.1 * Z₂.effect ab.2 -
   235	              Z₂.effect ab.2 * X₂.effect ab.1) ψ‖ ^ 2) := by
   236	  rw [sandwich_overlap_identity ψ X₁ X₂ Z₁ Z₂ hX₁ hX₂ hZ₁ hZ₂ hXZ hZX hZZ]

   241	        3 * (‖applyOperatorToState (Z₂.effect ab.2 *
   242	              (X₁.effect ab.1 - X₂.effect ab.1)) ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   243	          ‖applyOperatorToState
   244	            (X₁.effect ab.1 * Z₁.effect ab.2 -
   245	              Z₁.effect ab.2 * X₁.effect ab.1) ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   246	          ‖applyOperatorToState
   247	            (X₂.effect ab.1 * Z₂.effect ab.2 -
   248	              Z₂.effect ab.2 * X₂.effect ab.1) ψ‖ ^ 2) := by

   250	    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := ab

   253	    have hlin : applyOperatorToState
   254	        (Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b * (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a) +
   255	          Z₂.effect b * (X₁.effect a * Z₁.effect b - Z₁.effect b * X₁.effect a) -
   256	          Z₁.effect b * (X₂.effect a * Z₂.effect b - Z₂.effect b * X₂.effect a)) ψ =
   257	        applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b)
   258	            (applyOperatorToState (Z₂.effect b * (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a)) ψ) +
   259	          applyOperatorToState (Z₂.effect b) (applyOperatorToState
   260	            (X₁.effect a * Z₁.effect b - Z₁.effect b * X₁.effect a) ψ) -
   261	          applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b) (applyOperatorToState
   262	            (X₂.effect a * Z₂.effect b - Z₂.effect b * X₂.effect a) ψ) := by
   263	      rw [← DistanceCalculus.applyOperatorToState_mul, ← DistanceCalculus.applyOperatorToState_mul,
   264	        ← DistanceCalculus.applyOperatorToState_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
   265	      unfold applyOperatorToState
   266	      simp only [map_add, map_sub, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply]
   267	    rw [hlin]
   268	    set u := applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b)
   269	      (applyOperatorToState (Z₂.effect b * (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a)) ψ)
   270	    set v := applyOperatorToState (Z₂.effect b) (applyOperatorToState
   271	      (X₁.effect a * Z₁.effect b - Z₁.effect b * X₁.effect a) ψ)
   272	    set w := applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b) (applyOperatorToState
   273	      (X₂.effect a * Z₂.effect b - Z₂.effect b * X₂.effect a) ψ)
   274	    have hu : ‖u‖ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState
   275	        (Z₂.effect b * (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a)) ψ‖ :=
   276	      norm_applyOperatorToState_proj_effect_le Z₁ hZ₁ b _
   277	    have hv : ‖v‖ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState
   278	        (X₁.effect a * Z₁.effect b - Z₁.effect b * X₁.effect a) ψ‖ :=
   279	      norm_applyOperatorToState_proj_effect_le Z₂ hZ₂ b _
   280	    have hw : ‖w‖ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState
   281	        (X₂.effect a * Z₂.effect b - Z₂.effect b * X₂.effect a) ψ‖ :=
   282	      norm_applyOperatorToState_proj_effect_le Z₁ hZ₁ b _
   283	    have htri : ‖u + v - w‖ ≤ ‖u‖ + ‖v‖ + ‖w‖ :=
   284	      le_trans (norm_sub_le (u + v) w) (add_le_add (norm_add_le u v) (le_refl ‖w‖))

   287	        sq_nonneg (‖u‖ - ‖w‖), norm_nonneg (u + v - w), norm_nonneg u,
   288	        norm_nonneg v, norm_nonneg w]

   290	    have hv2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hv 2
   291	    have hw2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw 2
   292	    linarith
   293	  -- the contraction sum over `b`
   294	  have hcontr : ∑ ab : α × β, ‖applyOperatorToState (Z₂.effect ab.2 *
   295	      (X₁.effect ab.1 - X₂.effect ab.1)) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   296	      ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a) ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   297	    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type]

   302	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hsum

   313	/-- The pointwise bound on the consistency defect of the sandwich POVM between
   314	two placements, as a function of the point pair: one half of the
   315	`Z`-distance plus three halves of the `X`-distance and of the two placed
   316	commutator sums. -/
   317	def sandwichDefectBound (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p₁ p₂ : Placement)
   318	    (xz : PointPair P) : ℝ :=
   319	  (1 / 2) * ∑ b : PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   320	      (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect b) -
   321	        S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect b)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 +
   322	    (3 / 2) * ((∑ a : PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   323	        (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect a) -
   324	          S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect a)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2) +
   325	      (∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   326	        (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
   327	            (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) -
   328	          S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
   329	            (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2) +
   330	      ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   331	        (S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
   332	            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) -
   333	          S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
   334	            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2)
   335	
   336	/-- The pointwise bound is nonnegative. -/
   337	theorem sandwichDefectBound_nonneg (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p₁ p₂ : Placement)
   338	    (xz : PointPair P) : 0 ≤ S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ xz := by
   339	  unfold sandwichDefectBound
   340	  positivity

   342	/-- For a fixed point pair, the off-diagonal mass of the two placed sandwiches
   343	is at most the pointwise bound.  This is the consistency of the sandwich POVM
   344	between opposite placements, display `eq:rw-sc` of the proof of
   345	`lem:qld-4-10`, paper
   346	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:743-790`, in

   348	theorem sandwich_offDiagonal_le_sandwichDefectBound (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)

   350	    (∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, ∑ ab' : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,

     3	/-!
     4	# Self-consistency of the sandwich POVM
     5	
     6	The sandwich POVM `R^{x,z}_{a,b} = M^Z_b M^X_a M^Z_b` of
     7	`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Sandwich.lean` is approximately self-consistent
     8	between opposite register placements.  The source establishes this by a
     9	Cauchy--Schwarz chain (displays `eq:qld-rw-self-cons-1` to
    10	`eq:qld-rw-self-cons-4`); here an exact identity is used instead.  Writing
    11	`P_1, P_2` for the two placements of an operator `P`,
    12	`W_b = (M^Z_b)_1 (M^Z_b)_2`, and `D^W_c = (M^W_c)_1 - (M^W_c)_2`, the
    13	consistency defect of the two placed sandwiches equals
    14	`(1/2) ∑_b ‖D^Z_b ψ‖^2 + (1/2) ∑_{a,b} ‖D^X_a W_b ψ‖^2`,
    15	by two applications of the identity
    16	`∑_c ⟨w, P_c Q_c w⟩ = ‖w‖^2 - (1/2) ∑_c ‖(P_c - Q_c) w‖^2` for projective
    17	measurements.  The second sum is then bounded by the self-consistency of `M^X`
    18	and the commutators on the two placements, since
    19	`D^X_a W_b = W_b D^X_a + (M^Z_b)_2 K^1_{a,b} - (M^Z_b)_1 K^2_{a,b}`, where
    20	`K^i_{a,b}` is the placed commutator of `M^X_a` and `M^Z_b`.
    21	
    22	## Main results
    23	
    24	* `sandwich_overlap_identity`: the exact expression of the overlap of two
    25	  placed sandwiches.
    26	* `sandwich_defect_pointwise_le`: the pointwise bound on the consistency
    27	  defect of the sandwich for a fixed point pair.
    28	* `ProjectiveSetting.sandwichDefectBound`,
    29	  `ProjectiveSetting.sandwich_offDiagonal_le_sandwichDefectBound`, and
    30	  `ProjectiveSetting.avg_sandwichDefectBound_le`: the bound as a function of
    31	  the point pair, the pointwise estimate, and the average.
    32	
    33	## References
    34	
    35	Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:743-790`,
    36	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:851-880`
    37	(`lem:qld-4-10`, first step); the identity route is explained in
    38	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-points-direct.tex`.
    39	-/

    59	  congr 1

    81	        (1 / 2) * ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (A.effect a - B.effect a) w‖ ^ 2 := by

   313	/-- The pointwise bound on the consistency defect of the sandwich POVM between

   315	`Z`-distance plus three halves of the `X`-distance and of the two placed
   316	commutator sums. -/

   318	    (xz : PointPair P) : ℝ :=
   319	  (1 / 2) * ∑ b : PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   320	      (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect b) -
   321	        S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect b)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 +
   322	    (3 / 2) * ((∑ a : PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   323	        (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect a) -
   324	          S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect a)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2) +
   325	      (∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   326	        (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
   327	            (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) -
   328	          S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
   329	            (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2) +
   330	      ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   331	        (S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
   332	            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) -
   333	          S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
   334	            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2)

     3	/-!
     4	# Placement calculus on the expanded state
     5	
     6	This module records the algebra of the four register placements used by the
     7	combining argument: a placement is a unital `*`-homomorphism, placements on
     8	opposite register pairs commute, and the crosswise exchange of the two EPR
     9	pairs of the expanded state carries the placement `AA'` to `AB''` and `BA''`
    10	to `BB'` while fixing the expanded state.  The last fact transfers every
    11	state-dependent distance between the two bipartition schemes of
    12	`def:symmetric-equivalents` without assuming a symmetric strategy.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	The placements are those of blueprint `def:symmetric-equivalents`, paper
    17	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:420-450`.
    18	The ancillary permutation exchanging the two EPR pairs crosswise gives the
    19	same-side distance transfers needed here without symmetry of the strategy.
    20	It is not `U_σ U_θ` and does not formalize the full blueprint lemma
    21	`lem:symmetric-equivalents-transfer`. Its use for `lem:qld-4-10` is analyzed in
    22	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`.
    23	-/

   287	/-- The ancillary permutation exchanging the two EPR pairs crosswise:
   288	`A'` with `B''` and `A''` with `B'`, leaving the strategy registers fixed.
   289	This involution is distinct from `U_σ U_θ` in blueprint
   290	`lem:symmetric-equivalents-transfer`. -/
   291	def eprCrossSwap (P : AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
   292	    SixReg P ιA ιB ≃ SixReg P ιA ιB where
   293	  toFun := fun ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩ => ((a, (b'', b')), (b, (a'', a')))
   294	  invFun := fun ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩ => ((a, (b'', b')), (b, (a'', a')))
   295	  left_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩; rfl
   296	  right_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩; rfl

   298	/-- The EPR vector is symmetric in its two registers. -/
   299	theorem eprState_ofLp_swap {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   300	    [Nonempty V] (x y : V) :
   301	    (eprState V).ofLp (x, y) = (eprState V).ofLp (y, x) := by
   302	  change (if x = y then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card V : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0) =
   303	    (if y = x then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card V : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0)
   304	  by_cases h : x = y
   305	  · simp [h]
   306	  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

   308	/-- The ancillary permutation exchanging the two EPR pairs crosswise fixes
   309	the expanded state of blueprint `def:expanded-state`; only the symmetry of
   310	the EPR vector is used, with no symmetry assumption on the strategy. -/
   311	theorem reindexState_eprCrossSwap_psiHat (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
   312	    reindexState (eprCrossSwap P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) S.psiHat =
   313	      S.psiHat := by
   314	  ext i
   315	  obtain ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩ := i
   316	  change S.toStrategy.ψ.ofLp (a, b) * (eprState (PauliRegister P)).ofLp (b'', b') *
   317	      (eprState (PauliRegister P)).ofLp (a'', a') =
   318	    S.toStrategy.ψ.ofLp (a, b) * (eprState (PauliRegister P)).ofLp (a', a'') *
   319	      (eprState (PauliRegister P)).ofLp (b', b'')
   320	  rw [eprState_ofLp_swap b'' b', eprState_ofLp_swap a'' a']
   321	  ring

     3	/-!
     4	# Placement calculus on the expanded state
     5	
     6	This module records the algebra of the four register placements used by the
     7	combining argument: a placement is a unital `*`-homomorphism, placements on
     8	opposite register pairs commute, and the crosswise exchange of the two EPR
     9	pairs of the expanded state carries the placement `AA'` to `AB''` and `BA''`
    10	to `BB'` while fixing the expanded state.  The last fact transfers every
    11	state-dependent distance between the two bipartition schemes of
    12	`def:symmetric-equivalents` without assuming a symmetric strategy.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	The placements are those of `def:symmetric-equivalents`, blueprint
    17	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex`, paper
    18	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:420-450`.
    19	The EPR-exchange invariance is proved directly for the involution
    20	`(A' B'')(A'' B')`, which fixes the strategy registers.  Its use for
    21	`lem:qld-4-10` is explained in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-points-direct.tex`.
    22	-/

    39	/-- The `AA'` placement is the reindexed left factor of the
    40	`AA' | BA''(B'B'')` bipartition. -/
    41	theorem place_AA'_eq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    42	    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.AA'.side)) :
    43	    S.place .AA' O =
    44	      reindexOp (aaBaBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    45	        (heteroKron O
    46	          (1 : Op ((S.toStrategy.ιB × PauliRegister P) ×
    47	            (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) :=
    48	  (reindexOp_aaBaBipartition_left S O).symm
    49	
    50	/-- The `BA''` placement is the reindexed right factor of the
    51	`AA' | BA''(B'B'')` bipartition. -/
    52	theorem place_BA''_eq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    53	    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BA''.side)) :
    54	    S.place .BA'' O =
    55	      reindexOp (aaBaBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    56	        (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.toStrategy.ιA × PauliRegister P))
    57	          (heteroKron O (1 : Op (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) :=
    58	  (reindexOp_aaBaBipartition_right S O).symm
    59	
    60	/-- The `AB''` placement is the reindexed left factor of the
    61	`AB'' | BB'(A'A'')` bipartition. -/
    62	theorem place_AB''_eq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    63	    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.AB''.side)) :
    64	    S.place .AB'' O =
    65	      reindexOp (abBbBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    66	        (heteroKron O
    67	          (1 : Op ((S.toStrategy.ιB × PauliRegister P) ×
    68	            (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) :=
    69	  (reindexOp_abBbBipartition_left S O).symm

    71	/-- The `BB'` placement is the reindexed right factor of the
    72	`AB'' | BB'(A'A'')` bipartition. -/
    73	theorem place_BB'_eq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    74	    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BB'.side)) :
    75	    S.place .BB' O =
    76	      reindexOp (abBbBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    77	        (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.toStrategy.ιA × PauliRegister P))

    81	/-- Reindexing an operator commutes with the conjugate transpose. -/
    82	theorem reindexOp_conjTranspose {ι κ : Type*} (e : ι ≃ κ) (M : Op κ) :
    83	    reindexOp e Mᴴ = (reindexOp e M)ᴴ := by
    84	  ext i j
    85	  rfl
    86	
    87	/-- Reindexing an operator along an equivalence preserves positivity. -/
    88	theorem reindexOp_nonneg {ι κ : Type*} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    89	    (e : ι ≃ κ) {M : Op κ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    90	    0 ≤ reindexOp e M := by
    91	  letI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
    92	  letI := Fintype.ofFinite κ
    93	  rw [Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef] at hM ⊢
    94	  exact hM.submatrix e.symm.symm

    99	/-- A placement is multiplicative. -/
   100	theorem place_mul (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
   101	    ∀ (p : Placement) (A B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)),
   102	      S.place p (A * B) = S.place p A * S.place p B
   103	  | .AA', A, B => by
   104	      classical
   105	      rw [place_AA'_eq, place_AA'_eq, place_AA'_eq,
   106	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul, mul_one]
   107	      all_goals rfl
   108	  | .BA'', A, B => by
   109	      classical
   110	      rw [place_BA''_eq, place_BA''_eq, place_BA''_eq,
   111	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul,
   112	        mul_one, mul_one]
   113	      all_goals rfl
   114	  | .BB', A, B => by
   115	      classical
   116	      rw [place_BB'_eq, place_BB'_eq, place_BB'_eq,
   117	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul,
   118	        mul_one, mul_one]
   119	      all_goals rfl
   120	  | .AB'', A, B => by
   121	      classical
   122	      rw [place_AB''_eq, place_AB''_eq, place_AB''_eq,
   123	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul, mul_one]
   124	      all_goals rfl

   126	/-- A placement sends the local identity to the identity of the six-register
   127	space. -/
   128	theorem place_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) :
   129	    S.place p (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) = 1 := by
   130	  ext i j
   131	  cases p <;>
   132	    · simp only [ProjectiveSetting.place, Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff]
   133	      split_ifs <;> simp_all
   134	
   135	/-- A placement is additive over finite sums of local operators. -/
   136	theorem place_finsetSum (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) {γ : Type*}
   137	    (s : Finset γ) (O : γ → Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
   138	    S.place p (∑ x ∈ s, O x) = ∑ x ∈ s, S.place p (O x) := by
   139	  ext i j
   140	  cases p <;>
   141	    simp only [ProjectiveSetting.place, Matrix.sum_apply, Finset.sum_mul,
   142	      Finset.mul_sum]

   144	/-- A placement commutes with the conjugate transpose. -/
   145	theorem place_conjTranspose (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
   146	    ∀ (p : Placement) (A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)),
   147	      S.place p Aᴴ = (S.place p A)ᴴ
   148	  | .AA', A => by
   149	      rw [place_AA'_eq, place_AA'_eq, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
   150	        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
   151	      all_goals rfl
   152	  | .BA'', A => by
   153	      rw [place_BA''_eq, place_BA''_eq, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
   154	        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose,
   155	        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
   156	        Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
   157	      all_goals rfl
   158	  | .BB', A => by
   159	      rw [place_BB'_eq, place_BB'_eq, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
   160	        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose,
   161	        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
   162	        Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
   163	      all_goals rfl
   164	  | .AB'', A => by
   165	      rw [place_AB''_eq, place_AB''_eq, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
   166	        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
   167	      all_goals rfl

   170	/-- A placement preserves positivity. -/
   171	theorem place_nonneg (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
   172	    ∀ (p : Placement) {A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)}, 0 ≤ A →
   173	      0 ≤ S.place p A
   174	  | .AA', A, hA => by
   175	      classical
   176	      rw [place_AA'_eq]
   177	      exact reindexOp_nonneg _ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA
   178	        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg))
   179	  | .BA'', A, hA => by
   180	      classical
   181	      rw [place_BA''_eq]
   182	      exact reindexOp_nonneg _ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
   183	        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
   184	        (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)))
   185	  | .BB', A, hA => by
   186	      classical
   187	      rw [place_BB'_eq]
   188	      exact reindexOp_nonneg _ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
   189	        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
   190	        (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)))
   191	  | .AB'', A, hA => by
   192	      classical
   193	      rw [place_AB''_eq]
   194	      exact reindexOp_nonneg _ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA
   195	        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg))

   197	/-- The placement of a local operator bounded by the identity is bounded by
   198	the identity. -/
   199	theorem place_le_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
   200	    {A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)} (hA : A ≤ 1) :
   201	    S.place p A ≤ 1 := by
   202	  have h : 0 ≤ S.place p (1 - A) := S.place_nonneg p (sub_nonneg.mpr hA)
   203	  rw [place_sub, place_one] at h
   204	  exact sub_nonneg.mp h
   205	
   206	/-- The placement of a projector is a contraction. -/
   207	theorem place_conjTranspose_mul_self_le_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   208	    (p : Placement) {E : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)} (hE : IsProj E) :
   209	    (S.place p E)ᴴ * S.place p E ≤ 1 := by
   210	  rw [← place_conjTranspose, ← place_mul, hE.isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
   211	    hE.isIdempotentElem.eq]
   212	  exact S.place_le_one p (sub_nonneg.mp hE.one_sub.nonneg)

   215	/-- Operators placed on opposite register pairs commute. -/
   216	theorem place_comm (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
   217	    ∀ (p₁ p₂ : Placement), p₁.IsOpposite p₂ →
   218	      ∀ (A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side))
   219	        (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side)),
   220	        S.place p₁ A * S.place p₂ B = S.place p₂ B * S.place p₁ A
   221	  | .AA', .BA'', _, A, B => by
   222	      classical
   223	      rw [place_AA'_eq, place_BA''_eq, ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul,
   224	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul]
   225	      simp only [heteroKron_mul, one_mul, mul_one]
   226	  | .BA'', .AA', _, A, B => by
   227	      classical
   228	      rw [place_AA'_eq, place_BA''_eq, ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul,
   229	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul]
   230	      simp only [heteroKron_mul, one_mul, mul_one]
   231	  | .BB', .AB'', _, A, B => by
   232	      classical
   233	      rw [place_AB''_eq, place_BB'_eq, ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul,
   234	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul]
   235	      simp only [heteroKron_mul, one_mul, mul_one]
   236	  | .AB'', .BB', _, A, B => by
   237	      classical
   238	      rw [place_AB''_eq, place_BB'_eq, ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul,
   239	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul]
   240	      simp only [heteroKron_mul, one_mul, mul_one]
   241	  | .AA', .AA', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   242	  | .AA', .BB', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   243	  | .AA', .AB'', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   244	  | .BA'', .BA'', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   245	  | .BA'', .BB', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   246	  | .BA'', .AB'', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   247	  | .BB', .AA', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   248	  | .BB', .BA'', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   249	  | .BB', .BB', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   250	  | .AB'', .AA', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   251	  | .AB'', .BA'', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   252	  | .AB'', .AB'', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h

   254	/-- A complete measurement on a local expanded space, placed on one of the
   255	four register pairs, is a complete measurement on the six-register space. -/
   256	def placedMeasurement (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) {α : Type*}
   257	    [Fintype α] (M : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
   258	    Measurement α (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
   259	  Measurement.ofSumEqOne (fun a => S.place p (M.effect a))
   260	    (fun a => S.place_nonneg p (M.pos a))
   261	    (by rw [← place_finsetSum, M.sum_eq_one, place_one])
   262	
   263	/-- The effects of a placed measurement are the placed effects. -/
   264	@[simp] theorem placedMeasurement_effect (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   265	    (p : Placement) {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
   266	    (M : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) (a : α) :
   267	    (S.placedMeasurement p M).effect a = S.place p (M.effect a) := rfl
   268	
   269	/-- A placed projective measurement is projective. -/
   270	theorem placedMeasurement_isProjective (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   271	    (p : Placement) {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
   272	    (M : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side))
   273	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
   274	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (S.placedMeasurement p M) := by
   275	  intro a
   276	  refine isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   277	  · change S.place p (M.effect a) * S.place p (M.effect a) =
   278	      S.place p (M.effect a)
   279	    rw [← place_mul, (hM a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   280	  · change star (S.place p (M.effect a)) = S.place p (M.effect a)
   281	    rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, ← place_conjTranspose,
   282	      (hM a).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq]

   284	/-! ## The crosswise exchange of the two EPR pairs -/
   285	
   286	/-- The permutation of the six registers exchanging `A'` with `B''` and `A''`
   287	with `B'`, while fixing `A` and `B`.  This involution exchanges the two EPR
   288	pairs and reverses the order within each pair. -/
   289	def eprCrossSwap (P : AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
   290	    SixReg P ιA ιB ≃ SixReg P ιA ιB where
   291	  toFun := fun ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩ => ((a, (b'', b')), (b, (a'', a')))
   292	  invFun := fun ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩ => ((a, (b'', b')), (b, (a'', a')))
   293	  left_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩; rfl
   294	  right_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩; rfl
   295	
   296	/-- The EPR vector is symmetric in its two registers. -/
   297	theorem eprState_ofLp_swap {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   298	    [Nonempty V] (x y : V) :
   299	    (eprState V).ofLp (x, y) = (eprState V).ofLp (y, x) := by
   300	  change (if x = y then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card V : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0) =
   301	    (if y = x then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card V : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0)
   302	  by_cases h : x = y
   303	  · simp [h]
   304	  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]
   305	
   306	/-- The crosswise EPR exchange fixes the expanded state: the two EPR factors
   307	are identical and each is symmetric under exchange of its registers.  No
   308	symmetry of the strategy state is required. -/
   309	theorem reindexState_eprCrossSwap_psiHat (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
   310	    reindexState (eprCrossSwap P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) S.psiHat =
   311	      S.psiHat := by
   312	  ext i
   313	  obtain ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩ := i
   314	  change S.toStrategy.ψ.ofLp (a, b) * (eprState (PauliRegister P)).ofLp (b'', b') *
   315	      (eprState (PauliRegister P)).ofLp (a'', a') =
   316	    S.toStrategy.ψ.ofLp (a, b) * (eprState (PauliRegister P)).ofLp (a', a'') *
   317	      (eprState (PauliRegister P)).ofLp (b', b'')
   318	  rw [eprState_ofLp_swap b'' b', eprState_ofLp_swap a'' a']
   319	  ring
   320	
   321	/-- The crosswise EPR exchange carries the `AB''` placement to the `AA'`
   322	placement. -/
   323	theorem reindexOp_eprCrossSwap_place_AB'' (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   324	    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) :
   325	    reindexOp (eprCrossSwap P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   326	      (S.place .AB'' O) = S.place .AA' O := by
   327	  ext i j
   328	  obtain ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩ := i
   329	  obtain ⟨⟨c, c', c''⟩, d, d', d''⟩ := j
   330	  simp only [reindexOp, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
   331	    Equiv.symm_symm, place, eprCrossSwap, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Matrix.one_apply]
   332	  ring!

   347	/-- An operator placed on `AB''` has, on the expanded state, the same norm as
   348	the same operator placed on `AA'`, by invariance under the crosswise EPR
   349	exchange. -/
   350	theorem norm_place_AB''_eq_norm_place_AA' (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   351	    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) :
   352	    ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place .AB'' O) S.psiHat‖ =
   353	      ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place .AA' O) S.psiHat‖ := by
   354	  conv_lhs => rw [← reindexState_eprCrossSwap_psiHat S]
   355	  rw [WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState,
   356	    reindexOp_eprCrossSwap_place_AB'']

   358	/-- An operator placed on `BB'` has, on the expanded state, the same norm as
   359	the same operator placed on `BA''`, by invariance under the crosswise EPR
   360	exchange. -/
   361	theorem norm_place_BB'_eq_norm_place_BA'' (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   362	    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)) :
   363	    ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place .BB' O) S.psiHat‖ =
   364	      ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place .BA'' O) S.psiHat‖ := by
   365	  conv_lhs => rw [← reindexState_eprCrossSwap_psiHat S]
   366	  rw [WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState,
   367	    reindexOp_eprCrossSwap_place_BB']

   369	/-- Transfer of a same-side state-dependent distance between the `AA'` and
   370	`AB''` placements. -/
   371	theorem opFamilyDistSq_place_AB''_eq_AA' {X α : Type*} [Fintype α]
   372	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (μ : Distribution X)
   373	    (A B : X → α → Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) :
   374	    opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => S.place .AB'' (A x a))
   375	        (fun x a => S.place .AB'' (B x a)) S.psiHat =
   376	      opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => S.place .AA' (A x a))
   377	        (fun x a => S.place .AA' (B x a)) S.psiHat := by
   378	  unfold opFamilyDistSq
   379	  refine avgOver_congr _ _ _ fun x => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
   380	  rw [← place_sub, ← place_sub, norm_place_AB''_eq_norm_place_AA']
   381	  all_goals rfl

   383	/-- Transfer of a same-side state-dependent distance between the `BA''` and
   384	`BB'` placements. -/
   385	theorem opFamilyDistSq_place_BB'_eq_BA'' {X α : Type*} [Fintype α]
   386	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (μ : Distribution X)
   387	    (A B : X → α → Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)) :
   388	    opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => S.place .BB' (A x a))
   389	        (fun x a => S.place .BB' (B x a)) S.psiHat =
   390	      opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => S.place .BA'' (A x a))

   392	  unfold opFamilyDistSq
   393	  refine avgOver_congr _ _ _ fun x => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
   394	  rw [← place_sub, ← place_sub, norm_place_BB'_eq_norm_place_BA'']

/-!
# Approximate commutation of the field-valued expanded point measurements

The approximate commutation of `lem:qld-comm-cons` is stated for the binary
refinements `M^{(Point,W),u,r}_b` of the expanded point measurements.  The
combined point measurements of `lem:qld-4-10` are built here directly from the
`F_q`-valued measurements `M^{(Point,W),u}_a`, so the commutation estimate is
transferred to them.  The transfer is exact: since
`M^{(Point,X),x}_a = E_r (-1)^{tr(ar)} X^r(x)` and
`M^{(Point,Z),z}_b = E_s (-1)^{tr(bs)} Z^s(z)`, the commutator of the two
measurement effects is the Fourier transform, in the outcome pair `(a, b)`,
of the commutators of the expanded observables, and Parseval's identity for
the additive characters of `F_q` turns the sum over `(a, b)` of the squared
norms into the average over `(r, s)` of the squared norms of the observable
commutators.  No factor depending on `q` is lost.

## Main results

* `sum_norm_sum_smul_sq_of_orthogonal`: Parseval's identity for an orthogonal
  system of coefficients.
* `sum_fixedCharacter_mul`: Fourier cancellation for the fixed trace character.
* `expPoint_comm`: the field-valued expanded point measurements approximately
  commute on every register placement, with the error of
  `lem:qld-comm-cons`.

## References

The commutation estimate for the binary refinements is item 2 of
`lem:qld-comm-cons`, blueprint
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1139-1210`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:466-505`; the
Fourier form of the point effects is `def:expanded-point-measurement`, paper
lines 384--418.  The role of the transfer in the proof of `lem:qld-4-10` is
explained in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-points-direct.tex`.
-/

    simpa using (inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) x).symm
  have hj : ∀ j, ‖∑ i, c j i • v i‖ ^ 2 =

    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    calc ∑ i', ∑ j, ((starRingEnd ℂ) (c j i) * c j i') * inner ℂ (v i) (v i')

          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => ?_

/-!
# Self-consistency of the sandwich POVM

The sandwich POVM `R^{x,z}_{a,b} = M^Z_b M^X_a M^Z_b` of
`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Sandwich.lean` is approximately self-consistent
between opposite register placements.  The source establishes this by a
Cauchy--Schwarz chain (displays `eq:qld-rw-self-cons-1` to
`eq:qld-rw-self-cons-4`); here an exact identity is used instead.  Writing
`P_1, P_2` for the two placements of an operator `P`,
`W_b = (M^Z_b)_1 (M^Z_b)_2`, and `D^W_c = (M^W_c)_1 - (M^W_c)_2`, the
consistency defect of the two placed sandwiches equals
`(1/2) ∑_b ‖D^Z_b ψ‖^2 + (1/2) ∑_{a,b} ‖D^X_a W_b ψ‖^2`,
by two applications of the identity
`∑_c ⟨w, P_c Q_c w⟩ = ‖w‖^2 - (1/2) ∑_c ‖(P_c - Q_c) w‖^2` for projective
measurements.  The second sum is then bounded by the self-consistency of `M^X`
and the commutators on the two placements, since
`D^X_a W_b = W_b D^X_a + (M^Z_b)_2 K^1_{a,b} - (M^Z_b)_1 K^2_{a,b}`, where
`K^i_{a,b}` is the placed commutator of `M^X_a` and `M^Z_b`.

## Main results

* `sandwich_overlap_identity`: the exact expression of the overlap of two
  placed sandwiches.
* `sandwich_defect_pointwise_le`: the pointwise bound on the consistency
  defect of the sandwich for a fixed point pair.
* `ProjectiveSetting.sandwichDefectBound`,
  `ProjectiveSetting.sandwich_offDiagonal_le_sandwichDefectBound`, and
  `ProjectiveSetting.avg_sandwichDefectBound_le`: the bound as a function of
  the point pair, the pointwise estimate, and the average.

## References

Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:743-790`,
blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:851-880`
(`lem:qld-4-10`, first step); the identity route is explained in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-points-direct.tex`.
-/

/-!
# Placement calculus on the expanded state

This module records the algebra of the four register placements used by the
combining argument: a placement is a unital `*`-homomorphism, placements on

/-! ## Placements as reindexed tensor factors -/

/-- The `AA'` placement is the reindexed left factor of the
`AA' | BA''(B'B'')` bipartition. -/
theorem place_AA'_eq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.AA'.side)) :
    S.place .AA' O =
      reindexOp (aaBaBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (heteroKron O
          (1 : Op ((S.toStrategy.ιB × PauliRegister P) ×
            (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) :=
  (reindexOp_aaBaBipartition_left S O).symm

/-- The `BA''` placement is the reindexed right factor of the
`AA' | BA''(B'B'')` bipartition. -/
theorem place_BA''_eq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BA''.side)) :
    S.place .BA'' O =
      reindexOp (aaBaBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.toStrategy.ιA × PauliRegister P))
          (heteroKron O (1 : Op (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) :=
  (reindexOp_aaBaBipartition_right S O).symm

/-- The `AB''` placement is the reindexed left factor of the
`AB'' | BB'(A'A'')` bipartition. -/
theorem place_AB''_eq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.AB''.side)) :
    S.place .AB'' O =
      reindexOp (abBbBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (heteroKron O
          (1 : Op ((S.toStrategy.ιB × PauliRegister P) ×
            (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) :=
  (reindexOp_abBbBipartition_left S O).symm

/-- The `BB'` placement is the reindexed right factor of the
`AB'' | BB'(A'A'')` bipartition. -/
theorem place_BB'_eq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BB'.side)) :
    S.place .BB' O =
      reindexOp (abBbBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.toStrategy.ιA × PauliRegister P))
          (heteroKron O (1 : Op (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) :=
  (reindexOp_abBbBipartition_right S O).symm

/-- Reindexing an operator commutes with the conjugate transpose. -/
theorem reindexOp_conjTranspose {ι κ : Type*} (e : ι ≃ κ) (M : Op κ) :
    reindexOp e Mᴴ = (reindexOp e M)ᴴ := by
  ext i j
  rfl

/-- Reindexing an operator along an equivalence preserves positivity. -/
theorem reindexOp_nonneg {ι κ : Type*} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (e : ι ≃ κ) {M : Op κ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    0 ≤ reindexOp e M := by
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  rw [Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef] at hM ⊢
  exact hM.submatrix e.symm.symm

/-! ## The placement is a unital `*`-homomorphism -/

set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400 in
/-- A placement is multiplicative. -/
theorem place_mul (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
    ∀ (p : Placement) (A B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)),
      S.place p (A * B) = S.place p A * S.place p B
  | .AA', A, B => by
      classical
      rw [place_AA'_eq, place_AA'_eq, place_AA'_eq,
        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul, mul_one]
      all_goals rfl
  | .BA'', A, B => by
      classical
      rw [place_BA''_eq, place_BA''_eq, place_BA''_eq,
        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul,
        mul_one, mul_one]
      all_goals rfl
  | .BB', A, B => by
      classical
      rw [place_BB'_eq, place_BB'_eq, place_BB'_eq,
        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul,
        mul_one, mul_one]
      all_goals rfl
  | .AB'', A, B => by
      classical
      rw [place_AB''_eq, place_AB''_eq, place_AB''_eq,
        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul, mul_one]
      all_goals rfl

/-- A placement sends the local identity to the identity of the six-register
space. -/
theorem place_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) :
    S.place p (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) = 1 := by
  ext i j
  cases p <;>
    · simp only [ProjectiveSetting.place, Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff]
      split_ifs <;> simp_all

/-- A placement is additive over finite sums of local operators. -/
theorem place_finsetSum (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) {γ : Type*}
    (s : Finset γ) (O : γ → Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
    S.place p (∑ x ∈ s, O x) = ∑ x ∈ s, S.place p (O x) := by
  ext i j
  cases p <;>
    simp only [ProjectiveSetting.place, Matrix.sum_apply, Finset.sum_mul,
      Finset.mul_sum]

/-- A placement commutes with the conjugate transpose. -/
theorem place_conjTranspose (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
    ∀ (p : Placement) (A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)),
      S.place p Aᴴ = (S.place p A)ᴴ
  | .AA', A => by
      rw [place_AA'_eq, place_AA'_eq, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
      all_goals rfl
  | .BA'', A => by
      rw [place_BA''_eq, place_BA''_eq, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose,
        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
      all_goals rfl
  | .BB', A => by
      rw [place_BB'_eq, place_BB'_eq, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose,
        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
      all_goals rfl
  | .AB'', A => by
      rw [place_AB''_eq, place_AB''_eq, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
      all_goals rfl

set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400 in
/-- A placement preserves positivity. -/
theorem place_nonneg (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
    ∀ (p : Placement) {A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)}, 0 ≤ A →
      0 ≤ S.place p A
  | .AA', A, hA => by
      classical
      rw [place_AA'_eq]
      exact reindexOp_nonneg _ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA
        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg))
  | .BA'', A, hA => by
      classical
      rw [place_BA''_eq]
      exact reindexOp_nonneg _ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
        (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)))
  | .BB', A, hA => by
      classical
      rw [place_BB'_eq]
      exact reindexOp_nonneg _ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
        (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)))
  | .AB'', A, hA => by
      classical
      rw [place_AB''_eq]
      exact reindexOp_nonneg _ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA
        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg))

/-- The placement of a local operator bounded by the identity is bounded by
the identity. -/
theorem place_le_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
    {A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)} (hA : A ≤ 1) :
    S.place p A ≤ 1 := by
  have h : 0 ≤ S.place p (1 - A) := S.place_nonneg p (sub_nonneg.mpr hA)
  rw [place_sub, place_one] at h
  exact sub_nonneg.mp h

/-- The placement of a projector is a contraction. -/
theorem place_conjTranspose_mul_self_le_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (p : Placement) {E : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)} (hE : IsProj E) :
    (S.place p E)ᴴ * S.place p E ≤ 1 := by
  rw [← place_conjTranspose, ← place_mul, hE.isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
    hE.isIdempotentElem.eq]
  exact S.place_le_one p (sub_nonneg.mp hE.one_sub.nonneg)

set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400 in
/-- Operators placed on opposite register pairs commute. -/
theorem place_comm (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
    ∀ (p₁ p₂ : Placement), p₁.IsOpposite p₂ →
      ∀ (A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side))
        (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side)),
        S.place p₁ A * S.place p₂ B = S.place p₂ B * S.place p₁ A
  | .AA', .BA'', _, A, B => by

import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Points.Placement

/-!
# Approximate commutation of the field-valued expanded point measurements

The approximate commutation of `lem:qld-comm-cons` is stated for the binary
refinements `M^{(Point,W),u,r}_b` of the expanded point measurements.  The
combined point measurements of `lem:qld-4-10` are built here directly from the
`F_q`-valued measurements `M^{(Point,W),u}_a`, so the commutation estimate is
transferred to them.  The transfer is exact: since
`M^{(Point,X),x}_a = E_r (-1)^{tr(ar)} X^r(x)` and
`M^{(Point,Z),z}_b = E_s (-1)^{tr(bs)} Z^s(z)`, the commutator of the two
measurement effects is the Fourier transform, in the outcome pair `(a, b)`,
of the commutators of the expanded observables, and Parseval's identity for
the additive characters of `F_q` turns the sum over `(a, b)` of the squared
norms into the average over `(r, s)` of the squared norms of the observable
commutators.  No factor depending on `q` is lost.

## Main results

* `sum_norm_sum_smul_sq_of_orthogonal`: Parseval's identity for an orthogonal
  system of coefficients.
* `sum_fixedCharacter_mul`: Fourier cancellation for the fixed trace character.
* `expPoint_comm`: the field-valued expanded point measurements approximately
  commute on every register placement, with the error of
  `lem:qld-comm-cons`.

## References

The commutation estimate for the binary refinements is item 2 of
`lem:qld-comm-cons`, blueprint
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1139-1210`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:466-505`; the
Fourier form of the point effects is `def:expanded-point-measurement`, paper
lines 384--418.  The role of the transfer in the proof of `lem:qld-4-10` is
explained in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`.
-/

/-!
# Self-consistency of the sandwich POVM

The sandwich POVM `R^{x,z}_{a,b} = M^Z_b M^X_a M^Z_b` of
`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Sandwich.lean` is approximately self-consistent
between opposite register placements.  The source establishes this by a
Cauchy--Schwarz chain (displays `eq:qld-rw-self-cons-1` to
`eq:qld-rw-self-cons-4`); here an exact identity is used instead.  Writing
`P_1, P_2` for the two placements of an operator `P`,
`W_b = (M^Z_b)_1 (M^Z_b)_2`, and `D^W_c = (M^W_c)_1 - (M^W_c)_2`, the
consistency defect of the two placed sandwiches equals
`(1/2) ∑_b ‖D^Z_b ψ‖^2 + (1/2) ∑_{a,b} ‖D^X_a W_b ψ‖^2`,
by two applications of the identity
`∑_c ⟨w, P_c Q_c w⟩ = ‖w‖^2 - (1/2) ∑_c ‖(P_c - Q_c) w‖^2` for projective
measurements.  The second sum is then bounded by the self-consistency of `M^X`
and the commutators on the two placements, since
`D^X_a W_b = W_b D^X_a + (M^Z_b)_2 K^1_{a,b} - (M^Z_b)_1 K^2_{a,b}`, where
`K^i_{a,b}` is the placed commutator of `M^X_a` and `M^Z_b`.

## Main results

* `sandwich_overlap_identity`: the exact expression of the overlap of two
  placed sandwiches.
* `sandwich_defect_pointwise_le`: the pointwise bound on the consistency
  defect of the sandwich for a fixed point pair.
* `ProjectiveSetting.sandwichDefectBound`,
  `ProjectiveSetting.sandwich_offDiagonal_le_sandwichDefectBound`, and
  `ProjectiveSetting.avg_sandwichDefectBound_le`: the bound as a function of
  the point pair, the pointwise estimate, and the average.

## References

Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:743-790`,
blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:851-880`
(`lem:qld-4-10`, first step); the identity route is explained in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`.
-/

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# warm-worktree.sh — consumer side of the hot main build cache.
#
# Usage:
#   local/bin/warm-worktree.sh [<worktree>] [options]
#
#   <worktree>          Tree to warm (default: the git toplevel of $PWD).
#   --force             Re-clone the snapshot even if this worktree is already
#                       warmed or already has a populated .lake/build.
#   --build             After warming, also run a full `lake build` (takes the
#                       machine-wide full-build lock).
#   --no-build          On the cold path, do not run `lake build` (fetch packages
#                       only) — the caller accepts an unbuilt tree.
#   --force-cold        Ignore the snapshot store entirely and take the cold path.
#   --skip-packages     Do not run `lake exe cache get` (tier 2 already present).
#   --lock-timeout <s>  Max seconds to wait for the full-build lock (default 43200;
#                       0 = wait forever).
#   --status            Report what this worktree would do, change nothing.
#   -h | --help         Show this text.
#
# Local replacement for the *restore* half of the GitHub Actions build cache in
# .github/workflows/pr-ci.yml:143-149 (restore-keys prefix-match on
# hashFiles('lean-toolchain','lake-manifest.json','lakefile.toml')).  The cache
# there is saved only from main (pr-ci.yml:137-142, 161-167); here the warmer
# (local/bin/cache-warmer.sh) is the only writer and this script only ever reads.
# Protocol: local/protocols/build-cache.md.
#
# Two-tier cache split, which this script must not conflate:
#   tier 1  .lake/build    — this project's oleans; cloned copy-on-write from the
#                            warmer's snapshot, private and writable per worktree.
#   tier 2  .lake/packages — Mathlib and friends; fetched per worktree with
#                            `lake exe cache get`.  Never symlinked: a shared
#                            packages tree is mutated for everyone by any
#                            consumer that runs `lake update`.
#
# Runtime state lives under ~/.cache/mipstarre-dev/ and never in the repo.

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
LAKE_ROOT_HELPER="$SCRIPT_DIR/lake-root.sh"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- configuration

CACHE_ROOT="${MIPSTARRE_CACHE_ROOT:-$HOME/.cache/mipstarre-dev}"
HOT_MAIN="$CACHE_ROOT/hot-main"
HOT_REPO="$HOT_MAIN/repo"
SNAPSHOTS="$HOT_MAIN/snapshots"
CURRENT_LINK="$HOT_MAIN/current"
# Machine-wide, shared with the warmer and with local/bin/ci.sh.  The env var
# name matches ci.sh's so a single setting reconciles both if their defaults
# ever disagree (see build-cache.md §7).
FULL_BUILD_LOCK="${MIPSTARRE_FULL_BUILD_LOCK:-$CACHE_ROOT/.full-build-lock}"
TELEMETRY_LOCK="$CACHE_ROOT/.telemetry-lock"
LOG_DIR="$CACHE_ROOT/logs"

WORKTREE=""
FORCE=0
WANT_BUILD=0
NO_BUILD=0
FORCE_COLD=0
SKIP_PACKAGES=0
STATUS_ONLY=0
LOCK_TIMEOUT="${MIPSTARRE_FULL_BUILD_LOCK_TIMEOUT:-43200}"

FULL_BUILD_LOCK_HELD=0
INCOMING_DIR=""

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

log()  { printf '[warm-worktree] %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
warn() { printf '[warm-worktree] WARNING: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
die()  { printf '[warm-worktree] ERROR: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: local/bin/warm-worktree.sh [<worktree>] [options]

  <worktree>          Tree to warm (default: the git toplevel of $PWD).
  --force             Re-clone the snapshot even if already warmed/populated.
  --build             Also run a full `lake build` under the machine-wide lock.
  --no-build          On the cold path, fetch packages but do not build.
  --force-cold        Ignore the snapshot store; take the cold path.
  --skip-packages     Do not run `lake exe cache get`.
  --lock-timeout <s>  Seconds to wait for the full-build lock (0 = forever).
  --status            Report the planned action and exit without changing anything.
  -h | --help         Show this text.

Environment: MIPSTARRE_CACHE_ROOT, MIPSTARRE_FULL_BUILD_LOCK_TIMEOUT,
MIPSTARRE_TELEMETRY_DIR.
MIPSTARRE_LAKE_ROOT optionally relocates this worktree's `.lake` directory.
EOF
}

iso_now()   { date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z; }
epoch_now() { date +%s; }
stamp_id()  { date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ; }

# Ported from .githooks/pre-push: clear Git's per-invocation environment before
# invoking Lake or nested git operations, or an outer hook's GIT_DIR leaks into
# the vendored package checkouts and they resolve the wrong repository.
run_outside_git_env() (
  if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    for name in $(git rev-parse --local-env-vars); do
      unset "$name" || true
    done
  fi
  "$@"
)

sha256_stdin() {
  if command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}'
  elif command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'
  else
    die "no sha256 tool found (need shasum or sha256sum)"
  fi
}

# keyhash = sha256 over the concatenation, in this fixed order, of
#   lean-toolchain, lake-manifest.json, lakefile.toml
# MUST stay byte-identical to the copy in cache-warmer.sh (see the note there).
compute_keyhash() {
  local root="$1" f
  for f in lean-toolchain lake-manifest.json lakefile.toml; do
    [ -f "$root/$f" ] || die "missing $f under $root; cannot compute the cache keyhash"
  done
  cat "$root/lean-toolchain" "$root/lake-manifest.json" "$root/lakefile.toml" | sha256_stdin
}

ensure_lean_on_path() {
  if [ -d "$HOME/.elan/bin" ]; then
    case ":$PATH:" in
      *":$HOME/.elan/bin:"*) ;;
      *) PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"; export PATH ;;
    esac
  fi
  command -v lake >/dev/null 2>&1 || die \
    "lake not found on PATH. Run local/bin/worktree-setup.sh first, or install elan."
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------- lock primitives
# Same protocol and same lock directory as cache-warmer.sh: mkdir(2) to acquire,
# rename-then-delete to break a stale holder so exactly one breaker wins.

lock_info_field() { # <lockdir> <key>
  local dir="$1" key="$2" line
  [ -f "$dir/info" ] || { printf ''; return 0; }
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    case "$line" in
      "$key="*) printf '%s' "${line#*=}"; return 0 ;;
    esac
  done < "$dir/info"
  printf ''
}

# Portable directory mtime, used as a last-resort acquisition time for a lock
# written by another script in a different metadata layout.
lock_dir_mtime() { # <lockdir>
  stat -f %m "$1" 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y "$1" 2>/dev/null || printf ''
}

# local/bin/ci.sh records the holder as `owner` (pid / ISO time / tag, one per
# line) rather than `info`.  Read both layouts, so that neither script mistakes a
# live lock held by the other for an unreadable — and therefore breakable — one.
lock_pid() { # <lockdir>
  local dir="$1" pid
  pid="$(lock_info_field "$dir" pid)"
  if [ -z "$pid" ] && [ -f "$dir/owner" ]; then
    pid="$(head -n 1 "$dir/owner" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  fi
  printf '%s' "$pid"
}

lock_is_stale() { # <lockdir> <ttl-seconds>
  local dir="$1" ttl="$2" pid host started age
  pid="$(lock_pid "$dir")"
  host="$(lock_info_field "$dir" host)"
  # An absent host field means the lock came from a script that does not record
  # one; on a single-machine setup that is this host, so pid liveness stays
  # authoritative and a live holder is never broken.
  if [ -n "$pid" ] && { [ -z "$host" ] || [ "$host" = "$(hostname)" ]; }; then
    case "$pid" in
      ''|*[!0-9]*) ;;
      *)
        if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
          return 1
        fi
        return 0
        ;;
    esac
  fi
  started="$(lock_info_field "$dir" started_epoch)"
  case "$started" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*) started="$(lock_dir_mtime "$dir")" ;;
  esac
  case "$started" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*) return 0 ;;
  esac
  age=$(( $(epoch_now) - started ))
  [ "$age" -gt "$ttl" ]
}

break_lock() { # <lockdir>
  local dir="$1" doomed
  doomed="$1.stale.$$.$(epoch_now)"
  if mv "$dir" "$doomed" 2>/dev/null; then
    warn "broke stale lock $dir (pid=$(lock_pid "$doomed") held since $(lock_info_field "$doomed" started)$(lock_info_field "$doomed" purpose))"
    rm -rf "$doomed"
  fi
}

acquire_full_build_lock() { # <timeout-seconds; 0 = wait forever>
  local timeout="$1" waited=0 announced=0 ttl="${MIPSTARRE_LEASE_TTL:-43200}"
  mkdir -p "$CACHE_ROOT"
  while ! mkdir "$FULL_BUILD_LOCK" 2>/dev/null; do
    if lock_is_stale "$FULL_BUILD_LOCK" "$ttl"; then
      break_lock "$FULL_BUILD_LOCK"
      continue
    fi
    if [ "$announced" -eq 0 ]; then
      log "waiting for the machine-wide full-build lock (held by pid=$(lock_pid "$FULL_BUILD_LOCK"))"
      announced=1
    fi
    if [ "$timeout" -ne 0 ] && [ "$waited" -ge "$timeout" ]; then
      return 1
    fi
    sleep 10
    waited=$((waited + 10))
  done
  {
    printf 'pid=%s\n' "$$"
    printf 'host=%s\n' "$(hostname)"

usage: local/bin/ci.sh <pr-number> [options]

  Local replacement for .github/workflows/pr-ci.yml.  Runs the same eight
  jobs (build, blueprint-render, paper-gaps, blueprint-sync, file-length,
  proof-debt, proof-evasion, statement-origin) against the worktree of the
  PR's branch, with the same per-area change gating, and records the result
  where GitHub is the source of truth: one `local-ci/<step>` commit status
  per step plus `local-ci/summary`, all bound to the exact tested head SHA,
  and one idempotent manifest comment on the PR.

  <pr-number>        GitHub PR number (7 or 0007).  There is no prs/ tree
                     any more; the branch and base come from the PR itself
                     via local/bin/gh_common.py pr-view.

  --worktree PATH    Use PATH as the branch worktree instead of resolving it
                     from `git worktree list` / .worktrees/<branch>.
  --base REF         Override the base branch reported by GitHub (default:
                     the PR's base ref, else main).
  --only STEP        Run only STEP (repeatable).  Gating still applies unless
                     --force-all is given.  Makes the run PARTIAL.
  --force-all        Ignore change gating; run every step.
  --skip-build       Record the build step as skipped (operator override for
                     a machine that must not compile right now).  Makes the
                     run PARTIAL.
  --dry-run          Resolve, gate and print the plan; run nothing, write
                     nothing, post nothing.
  -h, --help         This message.

Outputs
  local-ci/<step> + local-ci/summary     commit statuses on the tested SHA
  PR comment <!-- mipstarre-ci-manifest pr=N -->   step table + manifest JSON
  ~/.cache/mipstarre-dev/ci-manifests/pr<N>-<sha>.json    per-step manifest
  ~/.cache/mipstarre-dev/ci-logs/<N>/<sha>/<step>.log     step logs (runtime)
  results/telemetry/builds.jsonl         one ci-build line when build ran

  A PARTIAL run (--only / --skip-build / --dry-run) posts NOTHING to GitHub
  and writes <sha>.partial.json instead: a debugging run must not be able to
  hand the review or merge gate a verdict it did not earn.

Exit status
  0  every gating step passed or was legitimately skipped
  1  at least one gating step failed or could not run, or the head moved
     under the run (the per-step statuses stand; no local-ci/summary)
  2  the run could not start (unknown PR, missing worktree, unresolvable
     base, local head != the PR's head) or its verdict could not be recorded
     on GitHub — fail closed, never a local fallback record

Environment
  MIPSTARRE_GITHUB_REPO           owner/repo, as read by gh_common.py
  MIPSTARRE_CACHE_ROOT            default ~/.cache/mipstarre-dev
  MIPSTARRE_FULL_BUILD_LOCK       default $CACHE_ROOT/.full-build-lock
                                  (must equal cache-warmer.sh/warm-worktree.sh:
                                  one path, one mutex)
  MIPSTARRE_CI_BUILD_LOCK_WAIT_S  default 14400 (4h) wait for the build lock
  MIPSTARRE_FULL_BUILD_LOCK_STALE_S default 10800 (3h) — applies ONLY to a
                                  lock whose owner stamp is unreadable; a
                                  lock with a live owner pid is never broken
  MIPSTARRE_CI_REQUIRE_WARMER=1   fail the build step if warm-worktree.sh is
                                  missing instead of doing a cold build
  MIPSTARRE_CI_ALLOW_COLD_FETCH=1 let the build step materialise .lake/packages
                                  itself instead of demanding worktree-setup.sh

There is deliberately no LOCAL_CI_ENABLED kill switch: a disabled CI would
hand the merge gate a green light it never earned.  See local/protocols/ci.md.
